subject: Request: extra lead time for demo prep & tentative reschedule
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Hart <sam.hart@acme.software>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — scheduling + data/sample prep

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time last week. I’ve penciled in a 60-minute demo of Redwood inference for next Tuesday or Wednesday (Nov 18/19) and wanted to check two things before I lock it down:

1) Do you have a representative sample dataset and a short list of prompt sets (or example user interactions) we can run during the demo? Having those ahead of time helps us tune the model variant, batching, and caching so we show realistic latency/cost numbers.

2) Is there anything we should avoid including (PII, sensitive columns) in the sample? If so, let us know and we’ll provide a secure uploader.

If your team needs more lead time to assemble sample traces or coordinate internal review, happy to move the demo out a week — I’d rather you see a meaningful run than a rushed walkthrough. Proposed slots:
- Tue Nov 18, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed Nov 19, 14:00–15:00 PT
- If you need a little more runway, we can aim for Thu Nov 20, 10:00–11:00 PT

Monica (cc’d) will help ingest any anonymized samples and prepare a short pre-demo checklist. If you can share the sample files or an S3/SFTP path, we’ll start the prep.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood_pre-demo-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Sam Hart <sam.hart@acme.software>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Lin <devon.lin@acme.software>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — scheduling + data/sample prep

Rafael —

Thanks for the note and the options. A couple of things on our side:

- Our ML/data team needs to pull representative workload traces and scrub a small portion of production logs. That will take us most of this week.
- I’m traveling Nov 18–19 (customer site) and won’t be able to join the earlier slots.
- Legal wants us to confirm any upload mechanism is TLS + restricted access.

Could we move the demo to Thu Nov 20 (your 10am PT slot)? That gives us time to: anonymize the traces, produce a short 1–2 page description of the sample workload, and grant temporary read-only access.

If it helps, we can also do a 20–30 minute dry-run with just our internal team on Wed Nov 19 for you and Monica to validate the uploads and permissions.

If you agree, I’ll ask Devon to assemble the sample schema and a small CSV subset and share a secure link (we typically use an expiring S3 pre-signed URL).

—Sam
Sam Hart
Head of Platform Integrations, Acme Software
sam.hart@acme.software

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood demo — scheduling + data/sample prep

Hi Sam / Devon —

Monica here from Solutions (happy to coordinate the ingest and prep). Nov 20 at 10:00 PT works for our team — tentatively confirmed.

A few quick asks that will speed the pre-demo work:
- Attach a 200–300 row CSV sample (remove any PII if possible).
- Optional: a short list (5–10) of representative prompt examples or user queries you care about (we’ll put these into a prompt set).
- If you can provide a JSON or CSV of token-length distribution / sequence length from recent runs, that’s extremely helpful for kernel selection and batching profile.

Preferred upload options:
- Pre-signed S3 URL (expiring link) OR
- Secure upload to our portal (I can send an invite)

Action items:
- Devon: share pre-signed S3 URL + small sample CSV + schema (acme_data_schema.csv) — by EOD Nov 14 if possible
- Rafael: will send calendar invite for Nov 20 10:00 PT and a pre-demo checklist
- Monica: will run an internal dry-run on Nov 19 11:00 PT to validate access and ingestion (invite to follow)

Attachments referenced: acme_data_schema.csv (expected), redwood_sample_prompt_set_v1.txt (template prompt set)

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

We’ll run the internal dry-run Monica suggested on Wed Nov 19, 11:00 PT to validate uploads and permissions; Monica will send that invite. If anything changes on your side (travel or legal requirements), flag it and we’ll adapt.
